title: Chris invited to take part in revealing something hidden at the pyramids

tellings.quote: I've been invited to go down there and u be involved in something that is going to release a something that was hidden.

plain: Something hidden at the pyramids of Giza in Egypt is due to be revealed in 2027, and a North Carolina man named Chris Bledsoe says he has been asked to take part. Bledsoe, who says UFOs appear around him, tells Michels he has "been invited to go down there" to be involved in releasing "something that was hidden", and he links the invitation to the Egyptian antiquities authorities. He does not say what the hidden thing is, but if true it would put him at the centre of a major discovery.
